stem: A child has suspected bacterial meningitis and no contraindication to cephalosporins. Which empirical antibiotic is most appropriate while urgent investigations proceed?
explanation: Suspected bacterial meningitis requires prompt empirical intravenous antibiotics. A third-generation cephalosporin such as ceftriaxone is a standard initial choice in many paediatric settings, adjusted for age and local protocols.
